## 4. Cannibalization

_A query is flagged when 2+ ACG URLs each hold at least 5 impressions and at least 10% of that query's impressions. Shares are of the whole query, so they sum to under 100% when other URLs draw impressions below those floors._

_Severity weights rank: HIGH is 2+ URLs on page 1, or a runner-up holding 30%+ share while still within position 20. An even split beyond position 30 is LOW - consolidating it wins nothing._

| Severity | Query | URLs | Impressions | Clicks | Top URL | Top share |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| HIGH | commercial glazing contractor west palm beach | 2 | 950 | 37 | `/west-palm-beach/` | 54.7% |
| MEDIUM | commercial glazing contractor nashville | 3 | 515 | 2 | `/commercial-glazing-nashville-tn.html` | 40.8% |
| LOW | commercial glazing contractor miami | 2 | 940 | 14 | `/storefront-glazier-miami-florida/` | 80.9% |
